highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews the Skia m155 engine update with current upstream servicing fixes.
highlights_body: It also refreshes HarfBuzzSharp, uses pointer-based GLES interop signatures, and removes unsupported RAW and DNG image decoding.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m155 and includes its current upstream servicing fixes.
RAW and DNG images are not decoded by this release; convert those assets to a supported encoded image format before loading them.
Updates GLES interop declarations to use native pointer-based signatures for accurate OpenGL ES integration.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Preview 1 opened the 4.155 line with the Skia m155 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Preview 2 added m155 servicing fixes, updated HarfBuzzSharp, and refreshed GLES interop.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8: Release Candidate 1 added the final m155 servicing refresh before stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library and HarfBuzzSharp binding to version 14.4.0.
